SPHEREx AI Sky Detective

Project Description

SPHEREx AI Sky Detective is an interactive web-based astronomy exploration platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project aims to make space exploration more accessible by providing a simple and user-friendly way to explore astronomical images, navigate sky regions, and understand important celestial targets.

The platform brings together several useful features:

  • Image Viewer: Allows users to view and explore astronomical images.
  • Interactive Sky Map: Helps users navigate and explore different regions of the sky.
  • Compare: Enables users to compare astronomical images and observations to identify visual differences.
  • Important NASA Targets: Highlights selected astronomical targets and provides an easy way to explore them.

Our goal is to simplify astronomical data exploration through an interactive interface that can be useful for students, beginners, and space enthusiasts.

By combining visualization, comparison, and sky navigation in one platform, SPHEREx AI Sky Detective encourages curiosity about the universe and makes astronomy more engaging and approachable through technology.

Our Vision: To turn complex astronomical information into an accessible and interactive space exploration experience.
